name: Heavy Rainfall in Zone A
description: Heavy rainfall may overload drainage and affect roads, traffic and emergency access.

name: Urban Fire in Zone A
description: An urban fire may affect nearby roads, traffic movement, power infrastructure and emergency access.

name: Power Failure in Zone A
description: A power node failure may disrupt connected services and critical infrastructure.

name: Water Pipeline Burst in Zone A
description: A major pipeline failure may cause waterlogging, road disruption and service interruptions.

name: Major Road Accident in Zone A
description: A major road incident may cause congestion and delay access to critical services.

name: Extreme Heat in Zone A
description: Extreme heat may increase electricity demand and place additional pressure on critical services.
